messages.subject: fit a dynamic model using Beta distribution as response.
parts:
Hi All, 

I am trying to fit a dynamic models using data augmentation. My response is percentage,  so I want to use beta distribution. 


----------------------------------------- Here is the partial code---------

Y <- matrix(NA, nd*3-2*n, 3)
Y[1:nd         , 1] <- final.sort$y100
Y[1:(nd-n) + nd, 2] <- 0
Y[1:(nd-n) + 2*nd-n, 3] <- 0

### indices for the f() function

id1   <- (1:nd)[-((1:n)*k)]  # remove 144, 288..... 
id2   <- (1:nd)[-c(1,((1:(n-1))*k)+1)] # remove 1, 145, 289.....

ix    <- c(1:nd, id2, rep(NA,nd-n))                        ## x_{,t}
ixb   <- c(rep(NA,nd), id1, rep(NA,nd-n))                  ## x_{,t-1}
w.ixb <- c(rep(NA,nd), rep(-1,nd-n), rep(NA,nd-n))         ## weights for x_{,t-1}
iZ    <- c(1:nd, rep(NA,nd-n), id2)                        ## Z_{,t}
iZb   <- c(rep(NA,nd), rep(NA,nd-n), id1)                  ## Z_{,t-1}
w.iZb <- c(rep(NA,nd), rep(NA,nd-n), rep(-1,nd-n))         ## weights for Z_{,t-1}
iw1   <- c(1:nd, rep(NA,2*(nd-n)))                         ## w1_{,t} 
iw2   <- c(rep(NA,nd), id2, rep(NA,nd-n))                  ## w2_{,t}
iw3   <- c(rep(NA,nd), rep(NA,nd-n), id2)                  ## w3_{,t}
beta  <- c(final.sort$enso2, rep(NA,nd-n), rep(1,nd-n)) ## covariate 



#### Create C.mat matrix
d <- sapply(neighbor, length)                   # vector with number of neighbors
C <- diag(d) - nb2mat(neighbor, style="B")      # structure matrix


### defining the Cmatrix to use with model='generic1' for v and w
st.cmat <- kronecker(C, diag(k))
#c.mat <- list(i=unlist(apply(st.cmat!=0, 1, which)),
#              j=rep(1:nrow(st.cmat), rowSums(st.cmat!=0)), 
#              values=st.cmat[st.cmat!=0])
c.mat<-Matrix::sparseMatrix(i=unlist(apply(st.cmat!=0, 1, which)),
                            j=rep(1:nrow(st.cmat), rowSums(st.cmat!=0)),
                            x=st.cmat[st.cmat!=0])


## formulating the model (revise)
## ---------------------
##
formula = Y ~ f(iZ, beta, model="iid", initial=-10, fixed=T) +
  f(iZb, w.iZb, copy="iZ") +
  f(iw1, model="iid") +
  f(ix, model="iid", initial=-10, fixed=T) +
  f(ixb, w.ixb, copy="ix") + 
  f(iw2, model="generic1", Cmatrix=c.mat) + 
  f(iw3, model="generic1",Cmatrix=c.mat) +1

# loading the INLA library
# ------------------------
require(INLA)


# call to fit the model
# ---------------------
r = inla(formula, data = data.frame(Y,beta,ix,ixb,w.ixb,iw1,iw2,iw3,iZ,iZb,w.iZb),
         family = c("beta","gaussian","gaussian"), 
         control.family = list(list(),list(initial=10, fixed=T),list(initial=10, fixed=T)),
         control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE, cdf=c(.025, .975)),
         control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=FALSE))


-------------------------------

I keep getting the error message: 

*** ERROR *** INLA.Data1: Beta data[172] (y) = (1) or weight (1)is void




But I have no data close to 1. 

Can anyone tell me what's going on there? 

Many many thanks,

Xintong Li
